components.name: Primary button
components.description: Existing generic action variant; touch height is pending alignment.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;border-radius:calc(var(--radius,.75rem) - 2px);height:36px;padding:8px 16px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s;background:hsl(var(--primary,151 43% 25%));color:hsl(var(--primary-foreground,60 24% 96%));border:0;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / .1),0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / .1);} .ds-button-primary:hover {background:hsl(var(--primary,151 43% 25%) / .9);} .ds-button-primary:disabled {opacity:.5;pointer-events:none;} .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring,151 43% 25%));outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Native search
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Find a set<input class="ds-control" type="search" placeholder="Search sets..."></label>
components.css: .ds-field {font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;display:grid;gap:7px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground,132 6% 37%));} .ds-control {font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;height:42px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid hsl(var(--input,88 14% 78%));border-radius:7px;background:hsl(var(--background,60 24% 96%));color:hsl(var(--foreground,140 16% 16%));font-size:12px;} .ds-control::placeholder {color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground,132 6% 37%));opacity:1;} .ds-control:hover {border-color:hsl(var(--primary,151 43% 25%));} .ds-control:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring,151 43% 25%));outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Series chip
components.description: Quick era selection with explicit pressed state.
components.css: .ds-chip {font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;min-height:42px;padding:0 13px;font-size:11px;border:1px solid hsl(var(--border,88 14% 83%));border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground,132 6% 37%));} .ds-chip:hover,.ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] {background:hsl(var(--accent,114 22% 91%));border-color:hsl(var(--primary,151 43% 25%));color:hsl(var(--primary,151 43% 25%));} .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring,151 43% 25%));outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Library navigation
components.description: Forest marks the active inventory destination.

components.name: Set specimen
components.description: Contained official imagery, truthful counts, and flat borders.
components.css: .ds-specimen {border:1px solid hsl(var(--border,88 14% 83%));border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:hsl(var(--card,0 0% 100%));transition:border-color .18s ease-out;} .ds-specimen:hover {border-color:hsl(var(--primary,151 43% 25%));} .ds-open {font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;padding:0;width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;text-align:left;color:hsl(var(--foreground,140 16% 16%));} .ds-well {height:174px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--well,#eeeee4);font:24px Georgia,serif;} .ds-info {padding:20px 19px 13px;} .ds-info h3 {margin:0;font-size:16px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.35;} .ds-info p {font-size:11px;color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground,132 6% 37%));margin-top:7px;} .ds-open:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring,151 43% 25%));outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Quantity stepper
components.description: Visible direct copy adjustment with tabular quantity.
components.html: 0
components.css: .ds-stepper {font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:hsl(var(--foreground,140 16% 16%));} .ds-step {height:42px;width:42px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:transparent;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;} .ds-step:hover:not(:disabled) {background:hsl(var(--accent,114 22% 91%));} .ds-step:disabled {opacity:.35;} .ds-stepper output {min-width:19px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;} .ds-step:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring,151 43% 25%));outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
A museum’s field catalogue translated into a collector’s binder: quiet cream paper, forest selection states, and carefully separated card specimens. Serif subject headings give the collection character while sans controls keep inventory work clear.

Artwork is evidence. Real logos and cards occupy neutral wells; counts and prices remain factual, and ownership is visible beside the controls that change it. The collection is local to this device and retains the existing version 3 storage format.

rules.name: The Ownership Rule
rules.body: Use forest to identify active navigation, selected filters, owned cards, and collection actions.

rules.name: The Subject Rule
rules.body: Use Georgia for subject headings; keep controls, metadata, quantities, and prices in system sans.

rules.name: The Specimen Rule
rules.body: Keep inventory cards flat; separate artwork wells from information with tone and borders.

rules.name: The Visible Quantity Rule
rules.body: Keep Add/Remove and quantity controls visible beneath artwork, never available only on hover.

dos: Do preserve contained card artwork and honest missing-data states.
Do keep focus visible and respect reduced motion.
Do keep quantity updates consistent across the set, collection, and detail views.
donts: Don't invent card counts, prices, release dates, or ownership.
Don't hide collection controls behind hover.
Don't add accounts, cloud synchronization, or replace version 3 saved quantities as part of visual work.
